'''Ptor''' was a tall, muscled [[Gender/Legends|man]] who looked after [[Trever Flume]] during his early days living on the streets of [[Bellassa/Legends|Bellassa]]. During the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] occupation of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], Ptor and other displaced citizens lived in a makeshift [[City/Legends|city]] inside an abandoned warehouse near the [[Moonstone District]]. He provided food and shelter to Trever and [[Eve Yarrow|Flame]] during their mission to Bellassa.<ref name="LOTJSW" />
